name: John Holt
source: Figures are in absolute naira. The audited statement is presented in N millions; values were scaled by 1,000,000 so the terminal renders them at the same magnitude as every other Nigerian board file. John Holt Plc consolidated and separate reports and financial statements for the year ended 30 September 2025, consolidated statement of profit or loss (absolute naira). FY2025 and FY2024 columns read from the audited statement filed with the Nigerian Exchange; FY2023 to FY2020 rows retained from the NGX filing library. | CRON 20260929_183159: FY2023 column filled from the same audited John Holt Plc consolidated statement of profit or loss for the year ended 30 September 2024 (file _ngx_pdf/JOHNHOLT.pdf page 12): distribution expenses 178 plus administrative expenses 509 give Operating Expenses 687, printed profit/(loss) from operating activities gives EBIT (871), tax income/(expense) (16) and deferred tax income/(expense) give a net tax credit of 42 so that printed profit/(loss) before taxation (1,042) less (42) equals printed profit/(loss) after taxation (1,000). All in N millions, scaled by 1,000,000 to absolute naira as elsewhere in this file. | CRON 20261001_200000: Profit Before Tax, Income Tax, Net Profit and EPS for FY2022, FY2021 and FY2020 written from the Company five-year financial summary in the audited FY2024 Annual Report, page 65 (printed in N'm, stored absolute); the rows tie PBT less tax equals net profit for all three years. NOTE: the same summary prints FY2023 PBT -607m / net -616m and FY2024 PBT 2,253m / net 2,231m, which disagree with the FY2023 and FY2024 figures already in this file, so those two years were left untouched and are flagged for re-collection.

source_note: Earnings per share are in naira per share; the audited statement reports 120 kobo for FY2025 and 634 kobo for FY2024. Income tax is the net charge or credit for the year, so FY2025 is -105 million (tax expense 7 less the deferred tax release of 112) and FY2024 is 99 million (tax expense 22 plus deferred tax of 77). The stored FY2023 net profit repeated the FY2024 figure and the stored FY2023 earnings per share of -616 kobo was not the filer figure, so both were cleared rather than carried. Net finance costs and income tax are stated as positive charges throughout the row. Earnings per share stays in naira per share and is not scaled.

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024, FY2023: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
